title: Part History search shows only the matching bin rows
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Bin locations {Bin-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINA) and {Bin-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINB) exist at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BINS-01) is tracked at {Location-A} in both bins, and its Part History has one entry whose row is split into a {Bin-A} row and a {Bin-B} row.
  • Your name as Part History shows it is {Staff-A} (for example Admin ShopView).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
  2. Type {Bin-A} in the search.
  3. Replace it with the name of {Staff-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The entry shows only its {Bin-A} row; the {Bin-B} row is hidden.
  • Step 3: The entry shows both bin rows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R28, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a split entry. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
